integrity: All algebraic identities are derived from the displayed vector field and independently replayed by the included symbolic checker. Literature comparisons distinguish analogous methods on other flows from coverage of this system-specific statement.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives necessary identities and endpoint rigidity for compactly supported invariant probability measures; it does not establish existence, uniqueness, ergodicity, mixing, chaos, or a complete attractor description.
title: Stationary variance parabola for the Aziz–Merie four-dimensional flow
